name: ComfyUI
tagline: Node-based local interface and backend for running Stable Diffusion and diffusion models offline.
real_test_summary: Tested locally on an NVIDIA RTX 3060 (12GB VRAM) using standard SDXL checkpoints. The node graph compiled cleanly and generated 1024x1024 images in approximately 6 seconds per render completely offline without cloud dependencies or watermarks.
pros: Runs completely offline with zero account signup or watermarks
Modular node-based workflow saves reproducible pipelines inside image metadata
Supports low-VRAM GPUs down to 4GB via automatic weight offloading
cons: Steep learning curve compared to standard prompt-box interfaces
Requires manual checkpoint downloads and Python or desktop dependency management
